title_as_printed: Table I (isopiestic molalities of KCl and NaCl at 25 C, with osmotic coefficients and Q)

footnotes_as_printed.*: Starred results: Q deviates markedly from unity; per text, the solutions are assumed not to have been successfully out-gassed (equilibrium not attained). Dist.: a = transport of solvent from the NaCl solution to the KCl solution, b = the reverse.

pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium in an evacuated vessel under the water vapour of the solutions; air removed down to the vapour pressure of water)

value.what: observed isopiestic molality of the KCl (unknown) solution; molality basis not explicitly stated, weights reduced to vacuum

value2.what: observed isopiestic molality of the NaCl reference solution

phi.what: osmotic coefficient of KCl interpolated by the author in tables of Hornibrook, Janz and Gordon (from e.m.f. data), not derived from this isopiestic run

phi2.what: osmotic coefficient of NaCl interpolated in the tables of Janz and Gordon

Q.what: Q = (m phi)KCl/(m phi)NaCl, should be unity at equilibrium

composition.other_species: each solution is a single salt in water (KCl in one dish, NaCl in the other); no mixed-salt solution is measured

extra_unmapped: phi KCl, phi NaCl (interpolated from literature tables)
notes: Constant T = 25 C from the title (stated 25 deg); thermostat controlled to 0.003 deg. Star marks are in the note column as Q:*. The printed trailing digits of the first three rows' molalities are subscript digits (e.g. 0.031720) and are written as ordinary digits.

row_held.reason: starred rows: equilibrium not attained per the author (Q 0.9951, 1.0059, 1.0037, 1.0036); 'solutions had not been successfully out-gassed'

quality_remarks: Four starred rows (m KCl 0.04563, 0.06833, 0.07201, 0.09022): the author states Q deviates markedly from unity and the solutions had probably not been successfully out-gassed; held. Both osmotic coefficients are interpolated from literature tables.
